text: Machine-wide work queue: get_prioritized_ideas descends into linked repos, and black-box repo nodes show a status rollup
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: after linking 9 repos into the life graph, value flows into each repo node, but get_prioritized_ideas stops at the box. Asked 'what's most valuable on this machine', an agent must call it per graph and compare numbers that aren't on the same scale.

Felix 2026-11-23: comparing globally "only is possible if they are all connected into one graph with a single normalized total value that spreads to supporting idea spaces." So: ranking starts at one top graph (e.g. the life graph) whose root carries the total value. The value flowing into a repo node becomes that linked graph's total, and its ideas get their share of it, so all numbers are on the top graph's scale. Graphs not reachable through links from the top graph don't take part. Read-only: no edges into another graph's internals. Repo nodes also show a rollup (open/partially counts, last activity).

Refuted if the cross-graph ranking stays worse than ranking each graph alone.

status.comment: Main part: get_prioritized_ideas descend: true ranks the open leaf ideas of the spaces linked from this one (checked out here) on this space's value scale: the value V flowing into a linked space's node replaces its total intrinsic value T, so its ideas' priorities and flowed values scale by V/T while their aggregated costs stay (priority = discounted reach / cost is linear in reach). Output: fromLinkedSpaces (tagged with the space), mergedTop (this space's ranked ideas and the linked ones by comparable priority), linkedSpaceNotes (not checked out, folder moved, no inflow, or another cost unit, which makes the comparison rough). One level down; read-only; a space's open ideas are read for ranking, which the descend rule allows. Rollup part done before (d3a5c59c): activity/missing in linkedRepo.list, MCP and settings; the canvas display waits on Felix's choice (13f35afe). Not covered: spaces linked by host on another server, deeper levels. Evidence: MCP test 'descends into a linked space on this space's value scale' (100 into the node reaches their only leaf as 100, a parent with an open child is no leaf, mergedTop tags the space; off by default), mcp tsc, pnpm check 25/25. The refutation test (is the merged ranking better than per space?) needs real use from the life space.
